author: Marialenam

title: Unfair refund policy
body:
I recently had an unfortunate experience with the Habio app's refund policy, which left me quite disappointed. I was charged $49.99 for a subscription that I didn't knowingly sign up for. When I contacted customer support with proof of the unintended transaction, I was met with a response that did not address my concerns adequately.

The customer support representative informed me that I had apparently registered for the subscription and pointed me to their Money-Back Policy and Billing Terms. While I understand the importance of clear terms and conditions, I believe that businesses should also consider cases where customers genuinely find themselves in unwanted subscriptions. In my situation, I had not even utilized the app's services.

Despite my plea for a refund, the response essentially stated that the charge could not be reversed. This lack of flexibility in addressing customer concerns is disheartening, especially when I hadn't received any value from the subscription.

I strongly urge the Habio app team to reconsider their refund policy and make it more customer-centric. Transparency and fairness are key to maintaining trust with users. This experience has left me with a negative impression of the app's customer service and policies. As a result, I can't recommend the app to others in good faith.

I hope my review can contribute to positive changes and encourage the company to prioritize customer satisfaction in situations like these.
